statement: theorem penalized_strictConvex (V X : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (hVX : V ⊆ X) (ψ : E → ℝ) (hψ : StrictConvexOn ℝ X ψ) (f : E → EReal) (hf : BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper f) (hs : ∀ z ∈ V, (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential f z).Nonempty) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (x : E) : StrictConvexOn ℝ V (fun z => (f z).toReal + η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x)
